text: A lot of men suffer like crazy after a breakup because they can't forget their ex. For days, weeks, months, sometimes even years. I receive a lot of messages from you guys and the questions about how to forget your ex or how to move on after your girlfriend broke up with you show up again and again. So I decided to re-record my old video on this topic because now I have a bigger audience and I feel like this is a very important subject. And by the way, even though this video is mostly for men, for the 13% of ladies who are watching me, I would say that most of these principles also apply to women. So if you found yourself in a situation when you don't know how to move on after breaking up with a girl, listen carefully, because this truth was carved out of the painful experience of thousands of men. Me included. First, you must realize that getting back with an ex is a path to nowhere. It is a dead end and under no circumstances should you allow it to happen. You might think that if you win her back, things will be different this time. This time you can make it work. You will be the best people for each other. Spoiler alert, no. Even if you get back together, the respect would already be damaged. The trust would already be damaged. The emotional balance would already be damaged. And deep down, both of you would know it. So step one is brutal but necessary. Accept that this chapter is over. Completely. Second, stop dramatizing the situation. It's just a breakup with a girl with whom things didn't work out. It isn't a catastrophe or a death sentence. It is actually your chance to build a better, happier life with someone else. Yes, it hurts. Yes, it is painful. But this is not the end of the world. What also helps is a change of perspective. Go to a hospital or an animal shelter and volunteer to work there for a day. There, people and animals deal with real loss, pain, illness, and survival. Compared to that, a failed relationship is not such a big deal. Third, cut all contacts. Completely. If she is your ex, her life is no longer your concern. What she posts, who she follows, who she goes out with, who likes her pictures, none of that is your business anymore. You need to unfollow, delete, block, mute. You need to stop feeding the obsession. And I know some people may say, oh, blocking is childish. No, what is childish is checking her stories at 2am and pretending you are just curious. Because every time you check her profile, you reopen the wound. Every time you look at old photos, you pull yourself back into the past. Remove the reminders, delete the photos, throw away the gifts. Clean your room, clean your phone, clean your mind. You cannot move forward if something keeps dragging you back. Fourth, fill your life with activity, especially meeting new women. One of the worst things you can do after a breakup is sit alone in the same room with the same thoughts replaying the same memories. You need to fill your life with movement, sports, hobbies, social events, friends, better clothes, a fresh haircut, nice food, and anything else that makes you feel like you are becoming a new version of yourself. But one of the most important activities is this. Go out and meet other women, download dating apps, make better photos, go to pies, go to bars, talk to women in real life. Because nothing helps you forget one woman better than realizing there are other women out there. Funny, caring, attractive, interesting, and genuinely nice to spend time with. And once you start meeting them, you begin to realize there was nothing that special about your ex. Another point is, stop talking about your ex with your friends, family, or anyone else. Tell them the topic is closed. Don't listen to depressing music or watch psychologists who encourage you to stay in your pain. Everyone heals at a different pace. It might take weeks or months. But the most important thing is never to take a step back. The moment you do that, you reset all progress. This phase will pass. Every man goes through it. And one day, you will look back and think, why did I even suffer so much over this? Because the version of you that comes next will be stronger, better, and happier. Move forward. Time works for men who don't stand still.
